say:1:1035208001:1.text: Technically, Ginny was the only one who got conned.
say:1:1035208001:1.source_cn: 准确来说是只有芙芙遇到骗子了。
say:1:1035208001:1.male: Technically, Ginny was the only one who got conned.
say:1:1035208001:1.female: Technically, Ginny was the only one who got conned.

say:2:1035208002:1.text: Yeah, she's always been too trusting.
say:2:1035208002:1.source_cn: 哎，她总是这样太容易相信别人了。
say:2:1035208002:1.male: Yeah, she's always been too trusting.
say:2:1035208002:1.female: Yeah, she's always been too trusting.

say:3:1035208003:1.text: I think this is the fifth time she's been scammed by the Adamant Syndicate.
say:3:1035208003:1.source_cn: 我要是记得没错，这已经是她第五次被黑金商会的人骗了。
say:3:1035208003:1.male: I think this is the fifth time she's been scammed by the Adamant Syndicate.
say:3:1035208003:1.female: I think this is the fifth time she's been scammed by the Adamant Syndicate.

say:6:1035208005:1.text: She buys whatever research samples and materials they claim are valuable without a second thought.
say:6:1035208005:1.source_cn: 每次芙芙一听说卖什么珍贵研究样本和材料，就非常爽快地付钱了。
say:6:1035208005:1.male: She buys whatever research samples and materials they claim are valuable without a second thought.
say:6:1035208005:1.female: She buys whatever research samples and materials they claim are valuable without a second thought.

say:7:1035208006:1.text: And she won't listen to anyone!
say:7:1035208006:1.male: And she won't listen to anyone!
say:7:1035208006:1.female: And she won't listen to anyone!

choice_prompt:8:1035208006.text: And she won't listen to anyone!
choice_prompt:8:1035208006.male: And she won't listen to anyone!
choice_prompt:8:1035208006.female: And she won't listen to anyone!

say:9:1035208007:1.text: That doesn't sound like a compliment...
say:9:1035208007:1.male: That doesn't sound like a compliment...
say:9:1035208007:1.female: That doesn't sound like a compliment...

say:11:1035208008:1.text: It's not that easy. Ginny said she was off to go grab them, but we know she's all talk.
say:11:1035208008:1.source_cn: 哪儿有那么容易啊。芙芙刚刚也说要去抓他们，但她也就是嘴...
say:11:1035208008:1.male: It's not that easy. Ginny said she was off to go grab them, but we know she's all talk.
say:11:1035208008:1.female: It's not that easy. Ginny said she was off to go grab them, but we know she's all talk.

say:12:1035208009:1.text: Even if she wanted to, she doesn't have the guts to follow through.
say:12:1035208009:1.source_cn: 就她那个胆量，就算有这个心也不敢付出行动的。
say:12:1035208009:1.male: Even if she wanted to, she doesn't have the guts to follow through.
say:12:1035208009:1.female: Even if she wanted to, she doesn't have the guts to follow through.

choice_prompt:13:1035208009.male: Even if she wanted to, she doesn't have the guts to follow through.
choice_prompt:13:1035208009.female: Even if she wanted to, she doesn't have the guts to follow through.

say:14:1035208010:1.text: Yes! When she was a child, she was deathly afraid of birds. We couldn't stop her from crying no matter what we did.
say:14:1035208010:1.source_cn: 当然了！我跟你说，她小的时候特别害怕鸟，甚至被吓到哭出...
say:14:1035208010:1.male: Yes! When she was a child, she was deathly afraid of birds. We couldn't stop her from crying no matter what we did.
say:14:1035208010:1.female: Yes! When she was a child, she was deathly afraid of birds. We couldn't stop her from crying no matter what we did.

say:15:1035208011:1.text: She said their long, pointy beaks terrified her!
say:15:1035208011:1.source_cn: 我问她为什么害怕鸟，她说因为它们的喙又长又尖，看着就很吓人！
say:15:1035208011:1.male: She said their long, pointy beaks terrified her!
say:15:1035208011:1.female: She said their long, pointy beaks terrified her!

say:16:1035208012:1.text: I don't know how I stopped myself from laughing back then. Birds probably have no idea they can scare people.
say:16:1035208012:1.source_cn: 天知道我当时是怎么忍住不笑的。鸟可能也没想到自己竟然还...
say:16:1035208012:1.male: I don't know how I stopped myself from laughing back then. Birds probably have no idea they can scare people.
say:16:1035208012:1.female: I don't know how I stopped myself from laughing back then. Birds probably have no idea they can scare people.

say:17:1035208013:1.text: I shouldn't say anymore, or Ginny will get mad at me.
say:17:1035208013:1.source_cn: 不能再说了，不然芙芙绝对生我的气了。
say:17:1035208013:1.male: I shouldn't say anymore, or Ginny will get mad at me.
say:17:1035208013:1.female: I shouldn't say anymore, or Ginny will get mad at me.
